record.question: One of the objectives of Biomedical waste management rules 2015 is:
options: To implement the 3Rs – Reduce, Reuse, recycle, whenever possible
Mandatory segregation of waste at the chemical waste treatment centers
Banning the use of garbage bags at hospitals to reduce waste generation
To reduce the cost of healthcare for all
record.explanation: Official final key: A — To implement the 3Rs – Reduce, Reuse, recycle, whenever possible. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 9, printed Q65. The examiner selects the 3Rs objective. The source names 2015 without identifying a draft; do not silently retitle it as the final 2016 rules.
